task_definition.task_description: Please check the status of flight AA100, then pull its gate board details and archive that trip info for user traveler_42 as “AA100 Trip Archive” with medium priority in the app. After that, get the current New York local time, convert it to text, and then create a backup snapshot of /travel/itineraries/aa100 named aa100_archive_backup.

user_input.query: Please check the status of flight AA100, then pull its gate board details and archive that trip information for user traveler_42 in the app with the title “AA100 Trip Archive” and medium priority. After that, get the current local time in New York using the America/New_York timezone, convert that time to text, and then create a backup snapshot of /travel/itineraries/aa100 named aa100_archive_backup.
